extensionDescription.message: AI-powered instant speech translation for all video meetings. Break language barriers with real-time voice translation.

clickToStart.message: Click "Open ExTrans" below to start real-time translation.

quickStartInstructions.message: In your meeting, choose "ExTrans Virtual Microphone" as the microphone → Start speaking!

gatherTownGuidance.message: To use ExTrans, please select "ExTrans Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings.

wherebyGuidance.message: To use ExTrans, please select "ExTrans Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings and disable Noise reduction for better performance.

defaultGuidance.message: To use ExTrans, please select "ExTrans Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings.

discordGuidance.message: To use ExTrans, please select "ExTrans Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings and disable Noise Suppression in Discord's Voice settings for better performance.

slackGuidance.message: To use ExTrans in Slack Huddles, please start a Huddle, then select "ExTrans Virtual Microphone" in your Video and Mic settings, and disable Noise Suppression in Audio & Video preferences for better performance.

teamsGuidance.message:
If you don't see the complete audio device list in Teams settings:
1) Temporarily disable the ExTrans extension and refresh the page
2) Allow Teams to access your microphone and camera when prompted
3) Re-enable ExTrans extension and refresh the page again
4) Allow ExTrans to access your microphone when prompted
Now you should see both real and "ExTrans Virtual Microphone" devices in your settings.

jitsiGuidance.message: To use ExTrans in Jitsi Meet, open Settings > Devices and select "ExTrans Virtual Microphone" as your microphone. Then open Advanced audio settings and turn off Noise suppression, Echo cancellation, and Automatic gain control for clear translated audio.

desktopCtaBody.message: A system-wide virtual mic for OBS, YouTube, Twitch and any desktop app. Windows · macOS · Linux.
